body.name: \(\mathfrak F_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
For observed blocks \(\mathcal O_G\), define the component-aligned compatibility fiber
\[
 \mathfrak F_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)
 =\left\{(\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\Gamma,\widetilde\pi):
 \begin{array}{l}
 (\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\Gamma,\widetilde\pi)
 \in\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}},\\
 \operatorname{Cov}_{\widetilde P}(\widetilde X^{(a)},
 \widetilde X^{(b)})=\Sigma^{ab}
 \text{ whenever }a=b\text{ or }\{a,b\}\in E
 \end{array}\right\}.
\]
Here \(\widetilde X\) is governed by the displayed component-aligned mechanism.  Thus this is the mechanism-theoretic subclass fiber, not a set defined from modified-Cholesky tuples or observable root scores.
